svg.aria-label: Stock Planner: what to order today. Animation: 40 possible futures of the shelf of Vitamin C 500 mg, 30 tablets in a fictional pharmacy; without an order it runs empty in 40 of them, with today's order of 50 in 9.
svg.title: Stock Planner
svg.text: Fewer empty shelves, less money in slow stock.
From the sales history: a forecast with a range
for every product, what to order today from each
supplier (packs, minimums, budget), and a replay
of the last weeks. Tested on Walmart's M5 data.
